description: Skill I/O contract registry for the ESTA pipeline. Phase 1 of notes/smart-pipeline-and-found-audio.md. The conductor reads this to (a) plan a pipeline backwards from the goal artifact, and (b) validate any custom skill order before running it — an order is valid only if every skill's `needs` are produced by an earlier skill (or already present in the session). Artifact paths are relative to sessions/<id>/ unless marked repo-level. Mode entries override/extend the skill's base needs/produces; 'status: planned' modes are part of the redesign and not built yet.

requirements.notes: Entry point. `licensing` field (free_only | fair_use_ok) added in Phase 2; honored by audio:found-fetch and assets.

voice-profiler.condition: requirements.example_scripts is a non-empty list (skip when it is the ASSET_COLLECTOR_PLACEHOLDER sentinel)
voice-profiler.notes: Conditional. Consumed by scriptwriter and humanizer.

research.notes: Append-only; re-invocable. In found-audio flows its output doubles as the hunting brief for audio:found-fetch.

author.notes: Default. Writes prose script BEFORE audio. Auto-invokes humanizer.

arranger.notes: Claude-native: selects + sequences pool clips into the arc. Writes script.md (human/plan-readable) AND arrangement.json (machine spec for audio:assemble; schema + validator in tools/scriptwriter/{schema,arrange}.py). Runs AFTER audio:found-fetch — the dependency inversion the rigid flow could not express. No humanizer pass.

clone.notes: Coqui XTTS v2 voice clone. Requires esta conda env + a repo-level voice_samples/ wav.

found-fetch.notes: Searches + downloads an audio/SFX pool by theme. Does NOT produce audio.wav — its output (audio_pool.json) feeds scriptwriter:arranger. Pixabay-audio (no public API) and FMA (dead API) dropped; LibriVox folded into archive (mediatype:audio). youtube gated to fair_use_ok. Use short keyword queries.

analyze-pool.notes: faster-whisper transcribes each downloaded pool clip and enriches audio_pool.json in place with transcript + word-level timing for speech clips (music/SFX flagged has_speech=false; >300s junk skipped). Lets scriptwriter:arranger select by ACTUAL content and cut spoken lines to exact word timestamps. Audio analog of assets' vision + transcript moment-finding.

assemble.notes: Stitches the arranged clips (arrangement.json) from the pool into a single audio.wav (ffmpeg concat/mix, crossfades, bed, silence). Honors the standard audio output contract so timestamps + everything downstream are mode-agnostic.

complex-placeholder.notes: Original multi-voice/SFX placeholder — superseded by found-fetch + assemble.

timestamps.notes: ALWAYS runs — the timeline's physics (ground-truth per-word/per-sound timing). In found-audio flows it runs on the assembled audio.wav and its transcript doubles as the caption track.

style-analysis.notes: Only needs requirements.json — can run in parallel from early in any flow. Phase 1 Python (OpenCV/CLIP/Whisper) in background; may use the Colab/Ollama server in config.

bulk.notes: Default. Two-pass generation of the full shot list; every shot streams to plan_progress.jsonl immediately (assets fetches without waiting for the full plan).

manual.notes: Hands-on per-line loop: one shot card is planned and shown for user approval; ON APPROVE the line is appended to plan_progress.jsonl (assets fetches it in background) and the NEXT card is presented immediately — approval and fetching overlap so the user never waits. Approval gates the plan idea only (option A); the user judges fetched picks visually on the live timeline and says 'redo shot N' (assets run.py shot). A render pass runs after each fetch so the editor fills in shot by shot. plan.json is assembled from the approved lines when the loop finishes.

plan.notes: Estimates timing at 150 wpm; reconciles to real timing when timestamps.json is present. Bare 'plan' tokens resolve to plan:bulk via default_mode (backward compatible).

assets.notes: Streams shots from plan_progress.jsonl. Licensing stance (Phase 2) gates source selection for copyrighted footage.

motion-graphics.notes: Generates motion graphics with HyperFrames (Node/Chrome, no conda). Full-frame MP4s overwrite the stock pick for MOTION_GRAPHICS shots in the assets feed (later line wins); overlay WebMs publish under '<n>-overlay' keys that render maps to extra Graphics-track clips. Zero-slot plans still write the done-marker. Runs alongside the assets background fetch; stock picks are the per-slot fallback.

ai-video.notes: Generative AI B-roll (Higgsfield-style camera moves) on Kaggle's free GPU. Three scriptable steps: push (upload notebook + start detached run), status (poll), apply (download clips, publish on the assets feed). Fills shots typed AI_VIDEO or carrying a `generate` block; publishes as ordinary assets_progress lines so a generated clip supersedes the stock pick for that shot (later line wins) with no render change. Stock stays as the per-slot fallback, so a failed or quota-blocked run never blocks render. Optional --seed-from-assets turns text-to-video into image-to-video by seeding from the frame already fetched for that shot, which requires assets to have run first.

render.notes: Deterministic assembler (no LLM). Writes <session>.openreel.json — the goal artifact the OpenReel web editor loads directly. Filename uses the session folder slug so each project on disk has a recognizable name.
